_meta.comment: v0.60.229 — curated 'directory' buildings: multi-tenant food halls / food courts / markets that house many separate eateries. Operator rule: never return the building or food-hall itself (Google Maps shows it with a directory listing of >1 tenant) — only the specific stalls inside. This complements the start-anchored BUILDING_NAME_PATTERNS regex in venue-filters.js with named entries the regex misses (food-court chain brands; markets that don't end in a 'food centre' / 'food court' suffix). Google's Places API exposes no directory flag, so this list is curated manually. Entries are matched case-insensitively, either exactly or as a start-anchored building name followed by a location qualifier ('Food Opera @ ION Orchard'). Kept deliberately conservative — only distinctive brand/building names — so a specific stall is never dropped by mistake.
